Very Poor Service
Nov 2017
I used to order pizza from here on a regular basis. I generally order pizza with extra cheese for an additional cost but it would be a common occurrence that the pizza would arrive with out the additional cheese in which I paid for. I tried contacting the management to rectify the problem but never got a response. So I wrote an honest review of the extremely sub par service I received... again no response. 

They now refuse to deliver on my orders. I was a regular customer but instead of responding to my valid concerns and reports of poor service they would rather not contact me to easily and simply make thing right as well as hold onto the extra money I paid for nothing. 

This is the worst service I have ever received from any business - especially considering I was a regular customer. The pizzas are great - when made to correct specifications/orders - but I just can’t believe the terrible service and manner in which they have behaved in this circumstance.

Online order failure
Jul 2017 • Solo
I ordered from Pendalosco a couple of times for home delivery through Vietnamm and never had an issue, this time they refuse to deliver and say I live too far away. It is incredibly disappointing to have been able to buy and suddenly denied. Service should be consistent and if there are policy changes they should ensure that their partners like Vietnamm ensure customers are not even given the option to order if they love too far away. I have to blame both Vietnamm and Pendalosco for the extremely disappointing service. There are plenty of other shops offering delivery to where I live so naturally with this disappointment lingering my mind I'll never order or eat in their restaurant again. Good luck with your business!

Super Italian with great thin crust pizza
Jun 2017 • Friends
The local Pendolasco in district 2 is our go to restaurant. Pleasant and efficient service topped with a wide range of good Italian food in a close location with an outdoor courtyard make it my favourite.
I often enjoy the seafood risotto which is creamy, tasty and cooked just right and then a second dish with veal. Last visit tried a pizza for the first time and found the crispy crust perfect. What really makes it special is the texture of the dough which manages to combine crunchiness with airiness, a thin crust and edge, complementing the tomato sauce’s fresh sweetness and fresh toppings. Just loved the pizza.
Will be hard choosing next time what to eat.
At meals end they always offer complimentary limonceloa. 
A definite to visit for Italian, pizza and friendly service.

Best Italian in HCMC
Jan 2017 • Couples
We live in D2 Ho Chi Minh City & I am a MASSIVE Italian cuisine fan. This is the best Italian you will find in Saigon. The owners take pride in what they deliver, and as locals, they will "make to order" dishes you like. We eat here at least twice a week, may sound tragic but it is worth it. We often order take away which is always hot & on time. But you can't beat the in dining experience.... visit their wine cellar for the best reds & prosecco outside of Italy, in Saigon. Good value for money & great food. Must visit. TIP; D2 restaurant is MUCH better than the one in D1.
